content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has scheduled the Group-2 Sub Group-1 Krashi Vistar Adhikari Recruitment Test 2026.

According to the official MPESB Student Dashboard, the examination is scheduled to start from 17 September 2026. The official dashboard currently does not show a TAC/admit-card hosting date for this examination.

Candidates should download the TAC only from the official MPESB website after it is officially released and carefully check the examination centre, date, shift and reporting time.
